name: Very Merrytime Christmas Menu: Carved Holiday Turkey & Horseradish Standing Rib Roast
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime "Happy Holidays" Dinner Menu
whyItWorks: Carved white Holiday Turkey Breast with mashed sweet potatoes and center-cut Standing Rib Roast (Prime Rib) are ultra-safe festive centerpieces.
prepOrOrderInstructions: On the Holiday Turkey, ask the kitchen to hold the crushed pecans on the mashed sweet potatoes and skip the herb stuffing/cranberries; on the Standing Rib Roast, scrape off the horseradish crust and order claret sauce on the side.
watchOuts: Crushed pecans on holiday sweet potato mash (ask to hold)
Pungent horseradish crust on rib roast
